verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents bulk import of many codes from other 2FA apps and plaintext files, plus whole-vault export and CLI-driven automatic backups. These are real many-item operations, but they cover only migration and backup. Day-to-day code management is documented per item (long-press or right-click to edit or delete one code). Missing for 10: bulk select/edit/delete/trash or tagging of many codes at once, scriptable bulk operations beyond export, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Ente Auth natively supports imports from many 2FA providers.
You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
This switch (export and import) was very easy.
